prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production sprite atlas for the existing Gathering Camper browser game.
Input image 1 is the edit reference contact sheet of the existing damaged sprites. Repair the CAMP OBJECTS (ignore bottles and the meter) into ONE consistent sprite atlas. Preserve their original subject, gritty hand-painted dark carnival style, colors, three-quarter forward-facing game view, and worn materials. The original cuts lost their dark pixels and portions of several objects; restore complete solid opaque object interiors and natural clean antialiased outer silhouettes.
Output a square transparent PNG atlas, exactly 5 columns by 5 rows of equal square cells, no borders, grid lines, labels or captions. Each object must be fully visible, isolated in its own cell, centered, with generous clear transparent padding on EVERY side (at least 12% of the cell). No part may touch a cell boundary. Objects should fill about 70% of their cell at maximum. Do not include a checkerboard or background; true alpha outside objects, opaque inside.
Row 1 left to right: purple camping tent; orange/red carnival tent; brown mud puddle; circular muddy hole (dark solid center); battered red golf cart with complete canopy, wheels and body.
Row 2: battered cream golf cart with full canopy, wheels and body; closed teal portable toilet (complete cabin); closed purple portable toilet (complete cabin); dirty yellow metal trash barrel; dirty red metal trash barrel.
Row 3: campfire with logs; teal folding camp chair with complete fabric and legs; red folding camp chair; red lidded camping cooler with complete body; maroon camping cooler.
Row 4: blue camping cooler with complete body; orange traffic cone with silver reflective bands and full base; rope between two wooden posts; purple carnival flag on two poles; weathered striped wooden barricade.
Row 5: fallen log; tree stump; pile of rocks; small campsite debris pile; dirty orange traffic cone variant.
Keep every asset detailed and legible at small game sizes. Restore missing geometry, dark areas must NOT be punched out. Avoid extra objects, typography, cut-off silhouettes, stray isolated pixels, shadows outside cell bounds.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent parallax backdrop layer for Gathering Camper.
The reference screenshot shows the existing dark carnival runner. Its horizon has ugly repeated moons and chopped sprite strips. Create a replacement panoramic camp/carnival horizon layer ONLY, not a screenshot or complete scene.
Wide landscape atlas image, roughly 3:1 aspect ratio. A coherent continuous hand-painted nighttime carnival campground skyline viewed head-on from a distance: varied dark evergreen trees, purple/red carnival tents, one small distant Ferris wheel with subtle magenta bulbs, and warm tiny camp lights. Preserve the game's grungy gothic carnival palette (deep purple, dark green, muted red). Readable restrained silhouettes; not photorealistic and not neon overloaded. No foreground road or character.
Transparent alpha sky above the tree/tent silhouettes; opaque dark interiors. Dark ground at bottom with a softly irregular transparent edge so it blends into the game's ground. Full complete skyline without duplicated mini-panels, no repeated moons, NO moon or stars, no text, no labels, no frames. Composition stretches evenly across the panorama, breathable openings near center. This sits below a separately rendered sky and moon.
